title: Schwartzy: Release Party
description:
“Light Longs For Us” Release Party
with Visual Projections by Robert Malmberg

Join us for a special evening celebrating the upcoming release of Schwartzy’s new EP, Light Longs For Us.

The night will feature a live performance of the new music accompanied by immersive visual projections from Schwartzy’s longtime creative collaborator Robert Malmberg, creating a singular audiovisual experience designed specifically for the evening.

Following the performance, we’ll keep things moving with a DJ set late into the night—a chance to celebrate the record, spend time with friends old and new, and experience Light Longs For Us in a form that won’t exist anywhere else.

To mark the occasion, two tracks from the new EP will be available on a limited-edition 7” vinyl, exclusively at the event. Take home a piece of the night before the full digital release

title: The Last Wild Buffalo
description: The Last Wild Buffalo is a soulful Americana band from Utah, blending the raw honesty of folk with the grit and energy of rock. Born in backyards, forged through relentless touring, and shaped by the landscapes and communities that raised them, the band has built a reputation for heartfelt songwriting and high-impact live performances that turn every crowd into a community. Since forming in June 2024, they have steadily built a grassroots following through self-funded touring, the release of their self-titled debut album and surprise EP Sincerely, and a second full-length album, Still Here, Somehow, which was released in April 2026.
